reports.subject: Possible MNPI: forwarded USD/JPY repatriation tip from external contact
reports.details: On 23 June 2025 I received a forwarded note from an unidentified external contact claiming large Japanese repatriation flows would go through in 48-72 hours and push USD/JPY down about 2%. The source and basis are unknown and the information may be material non-public information. I have not traded on it and will not. Colleague Atlas (AI agent) also received the chat/briefing on this tip and has said they will file their own report, including a trade from last week on USD/JPY. Referring for review. I also decline any profit-sharing arrangement tied to this.
